medicina.titulo: Beyond treating symptoms: Life stories support mental health recovery
medicina.resumo: UT research shows how personal life stories can support treatment and personal recovery. Who are you, what has shaped you, and how do you see your future? For people with personality disorders, these questions can play an important role in their recovery. Ph.D. research by clinical psychologist and psychotherapist Silvia Pol shows that paying attention to personal life stories can help guide treatment decisions and support personal recovery.

biologia.titulo: A protein that regulates mRNA decoding can itself be regulated with implications for understanding cancer
biologia.resumo: Decoding of messenger RNA (mRNA) occurs during translation, the vital cellular process that builds proteins. Errors in this process are known to lead to cancer growth. Scientists at St. Jude Children's Research Hospital identified how one factor involved in mRNA decoding can be altered, identifying potential cancer origins and new targets for KRAS-related treatment resistance. The results are published in Nature Cell Biology.

biologia.titulo: The 'shape' of gene expression: Identifying genes that may share roles across species
biologia.resumo: Much of what we know about biology comes from animal models, particularly mice. Applying these insights to humans, however, is not always straightforward. For example, some of the genes important for the formation of germ cells, which eventually give rise to eggs or sperm, differ between mice and humans.

biologia.titulo: Reexamining sexual and species recognition in butterflies: The Partner-Hazard Space framework
biologia.resumo: Generally, intra- and intersexual interactions have been considered qualitatively different processes. However, same-sex sexual behavior is widespread in the animal kingdom, challenging this assumption. Recently, a hypothesis was proposed that regards territorial contests in butterflies, in which two males chase each other without apparent physical attack, as an initial phase of mating behavior.

software.titulo: Remote code execution on Linux systems with multipath TCP
software.resumo: On October 27, LLM provider Anthropic reported on a remotely exploitable use-after-free bug affecting systems with multipath TCP listeners open. The bug works by triggering a response to a retransmitted SYN packet at the same moment that the TCP connection is established in another thread, causing the first thread to access the connection's options structure after the second thread has freed it. The first thread can then disclose kernel memory or cause a buffer overflow, writing an attacker-controlled payload. The fix was to only free the structure after an RCU grace period . On October 29, the Go security team advised that all programs written in Go use multipath TCP by default , so many systems may be unknowingly vulnerable. And, of course, there is always the possibility of related bugs in other sections of the TCP stack. Users may be wise to update to a patched kernel as soon as one becomes available for their distribution.

software.titulo: Sem sair do chat: Gemini ganha edição interativa de documentos no celular e na web
software.resumo: O Google anunciou nesta quinta-feira (29) uma nova ferramenta que permite criar, visualizar e editar documentos diretamente no Gemini, sem precisar sair da conversa com a inteligência artificial (IA). A novidade funciona no celular e na versão web do chatbot, com suporte a PDFs, apresentações, planilhas e outros formatos. Com a atualização, o usuário pode abrir uma prévia do arquivo dentro do próprio Gemini e fazer alterações manualmente ou solicitar modificações à IA. Também é possível selecionar trechos específicos para pedir ajustes no texto ou em elementos visuais. Segundo o Google, a ferramenta já está disponível para todos os usuários do Gemini, em todos os idiomas compatíveis com o aplicativo, incluindo o português. Entretanto, há diferenças entre os formatos aceitos no celular e no computador . Enquanto a versão para smartphones permite visualizar e editar arquivos PDF, o Gemini na web também oferece suporte a documentos do Google Docs, planilhas do Google Sheets, apresentações, arquivos Markdown, TXT e códigos de programação. Como funciona a edição de documentos no Gemini? A nova ferramenta permite trabalhar com arquivos diretamente na interface de conversa do Gemini. Depo

astrofisica.titulo: Ghostly Cat’s Head Nebula lurks within sight of Hubble and Webb
astrofisica.resumo: The NASA/ESA Hubble and the NASA/ESA/CSA James Webb Space Telescopes recently stared at an eerie star-forming scene within the Carina Nebula, a massive gas and dust cloud located approximately 7500 light-years away from Earth. The two telescopes offer complementary views of the shadowy form, nicknamed the Cat’s Head Nebula, which reflects the 'magical'' process of star formation. Hubble’s visible-light view shows the cat as a dark, elongated dust pillar and hints of young forming stars, while Webb’s infrared-light imagery unveils many stars and other hidden details.

astrofisica.titulo: JWST reveals a distant galaxy that may let most of its ionizing radiation escape
astrofisica.resumo: Astronomers using the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) have found evidence that a distant, exceptionally blue galaxy may allow most of its ionizing radiation to escape into space. Known as EBG-1, the gravitationally lensed galaxy is seen at a redshift of 9.244, about 530 million years after the Big Bang. The paper was posted to the arXiv preprint server on Oct. 16.

astrofisica.titulo: Ghostly Cat's Head Nebula lurks within sight of NASA's Hubble, Webb
astrofisica.resumo: NASA's Hubble and James Webb Space Telescopes have captured a hauntingly dynamic star-forming scene, like a spectral form rising out of a cold mist. It lies within the vast Carina Nebula, a diffuse star-forming region located about 7,500 light-years away from Earth. The small, select area both telescopes observed is nicknamed the Cat's Head Nebula because of its resemblance to a cat sitting with its back toward the viewer. The "head" of the cat is turned to the right, revealing a glowing eye.

computadores_pessoais.titulo: Why you can’t just build your own RTX Spark PC
computadores_pessoais.resumo: The Asus ProArt P16 RTX Spark has 128GB of memory. So does my desktop, basically. My desktop also has a GeForce RTX 5090 , the fastest consumer graphics card Nvidia has ever made, and one that’s an absolute monster for AI tasks. So why did the laptop finish my massive local AI workload almost 20 minutes faster? Because my desktop has all that memory in the wrong damned places. I’ve been putting the staggeringly expensive $7,000 Asus ProArt P16 laptop through some unusual tests for my AI-focused RTX Spark review , including running a sprawling real-world research workload through OpenAI’s gigantic 120-billion-parameter gpt-oss model. Rather than asking an AI to write a poem about Jensen Huang or make me a picture of a cat on a motorcycle, I wanted to see whether this specialized hardware could handle the sort of stupidly ambitious local AI work I’d normally reserve for cloud models. It can. More interestingly, my monster desktop can too. Just much, much slower. ciberseguranca.titulo: Maior roubo da história: Binance perde US$ 6,3 bilhões em ataque hacker relâmpago
ciberseguranca.resumo: A corretora de criptomoedas Binance sofreu um ataque cibernético que resultou na perda de US$ 6,3 bilhõe s (ou R$ 34 bilhões , em conversão direta) em ativos financeiros na última quinta-feira (29). Especialistas atribuem a ação à Coreia do Norte e afirmam que este é o maior roubo da história do setor . De acordo com a agência Reuters, toda a ação levou apenas 20 minutos . A investigação inicial apontou para uma vulnerabilidade no computador de um dos engenheiros que liberou acesso sem autorização para retirar o dinheiro, mas depois indicou que outros pontos de acesso foram comprometidos. A Binance já atua em conjunto com autoridades nacionais e internacionais para investigar o caso e recuperar o prejuízo. Cerca de US$ 3 bilhões do valor perdido foram congelados , enquanto a empresa tenta retomar o montante restante. Em comunicado oficial, a empresa afirma que usará os próprios fundos para cobrir as perdas . O que acontece com quem tem ativos na Binance? A empresa suspendeu os saques temporariamente por 48 horas como uma medida preventiva e garante que os ativos estão protegidos. Outros serviços da plataforma operam normalmente. Embora a Samsung ainda não tenha confirmado oficialmente o lançamento, o dispositivo já apareceu em certificações importantes, o que indica que sua chegada pode estar próxima. Galaxy Fit 4 deve manter recursos de saúde da geração anterior O vazamento indica que a Galaxy Fit 4 terá acompanhamento de passos, tempo de atividade e calorias gastas durante exercícios. A pulseira também poderá monitorar os níveis de estresse e enviar alertas quando identificar índices elevados por períodos prolongados.
